# Recurrence without decidedness

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> In a finite family, recurring coming to be refutes any end to ceasing, and conversely; decided where it is sought, the step is found, and decided from some step on, the two recur together.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

In a finite family, while nothing of it ceases each member comes to be at most once (comes_once), and while nothing comes to be each ceases at most once (ceases_once_of); so no more steps of a stretch see a member come to be, or cease, than the family has members (coming_steps_within, ceasing_steps_within). Hence, where coming to be recurs, from any step there is a stretch in which something ceasing cannot be refuted (Recurs.ceasing_within), and ceasing never stops for good: that from some step on nothing ceases is refuted (Recurs.ceasing_not_stopping); and conversely (Recurs.coming_within, Recurs.coming_not_stopping). No decidedness is used. With the states of that stretch decided, the step is found (Recurs.ceasing_found, Recurs.coming_found); decided from some step on, coming to be recurs exactly where ceasing does (coming_recurs_iff_decided), with no decision procedure, where coming_recurs_iff asks one at every step. The same holds of a web with finitely many formations (Web.unceasing_iff_decided). In a finite world, where arising recurs ceasing never stops for good, and conversely, with no decidedness (World.ceasing_not_stopping, World.arising_not_stopping); decided from some step on, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does (World.arising_iff_ceasing_decided), World.arising_iff_ceasing being the case decided by a procedure from the first step (World.arising_iff_ceasing_of_decidable); with a list covering what is active from some step on the same holds, decidedness asked only of the list's members (World.ceasing_not_stopping_covered, World.arising_not_stopping_covered, World.arising_iff_ceasing_covered). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Decidedness.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Decidedness.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The forms that never stop: the family is finite (a list covers it), with no decidedness.
- The forms finding a step: the states of the stretch searched decided; the forms recurring together: decided from some step on.
- Discrete steps.

Ren, 11 October 2026: “give me more context, but i intuitively feel decidability is too dualist, also proved solutions and their pro/cons”, and “please” to the AI's suggestion that decidability be made local, no longer a commitment of the representation. The AI's reading: the forms that never stop are recurrence doubly negated, naming no step but excluding “none from some step on”; this is the proved boundary: without decidedness, naming a step needs the limited principle of omniscience (World.lpo_of_finite_ends, Listed.lpo_of_few, Web.lpo_of_ending), and asking recurrence of every finite world needs excluded middle (World.law_iff_em). The reading is adopted on Ren's delegation.

The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §84 of the integration note; not yet independently reviewed.

The forms that never stop name no step; naming one needs decidedness where it is sought, and asking recurrence of every world needs decidedness from some step on; stated for discrete steps; the readings are the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation.

- The undecided world (World.undecided) is finite, with arising recurring (World.undecided_world); a law giving ceasing recurring from arising recurring in every finite world decides any proposition Q at undecided Q (World.law_decides), so asking the exact recurrence law of every finite world without decidedness is excluded middle (World.law_iff_em); the forms that never stop ask no decidedness. <a id="依赖与关联-dependencies-and-related-results"></a>
## Dependencies and related results

- **formal-reuse**: [coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace](coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace.md). Reuses coming to be and ceasing (ComesToBe, CeasesToBe) and recurrence in a family (Recurs).
- **formal-reuse**: [space-and-its-parts](space-and-its-parts.md). Reuses worlds, finiteness, and arising and ceasing recurring (World, World.Finite, World.ArisingRecurs, World.CeasingRecurs).

**Output:** Coming to be, ceasing and their recurrence; in a finite family, with a decision procedure, each recurs exactly when the other does (coming_recurs_iff).

**Input:** The same law with no decision procedure: the forms that never stop, and the form decided from some step on.

**Preserved conditions:** A finite family. [Change.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Change.lean)


**Output:** Worlds and their recurrence; in a finite world whose activity is decided, arising recurs exactly when ceasing does (World.arising_iff_ceasing).

**Input:** For finite worlds, the forms without decidedness and the form decided from some step on.

**Preserved conditions:** A finite world, or a list covering what is active from some step on. [Space.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Space.lean)

- Related, not a proved adapter: [counts-exist-where-decided](counts-exist-where-decided.md). The same module: counting as a relation.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [recurrence-without-premise](recurrence-without-premise.md). There every law of change, with no premise, is lossless exactly when it returns within finite configurations; here the recurrence of a finite family needs no decidedness.
- Related, not a proved adapter: [laws-of-one-step](laws-of-one-step.md). There, with a list covering what is active from some step on, ceasing recurring leaves a later arising unrefuted after every step (Covers.not_not_coming_from); here, with such a list, the forms of recurrence that never stop, and the law asking decidedness only of the list's members.
